messages:
sara: Heads-up — CrescentPay asked for a private deploy + KMS integration + committed 100 qps SLA by May 15. They want a written commitment for the quarter.
clare: that's... tight. May 15 is ~7 weeks out. Do we know which infra region and whether they need on-prem or VPC?
james (CrescentPay): We prefer VPC in us-west-2. On-prem is not required. KMS must be customer-managed (BYOK). 100 qps is a hard requirement for peak hours.
raj: 100 qps sustained with low latency depends on model choice and batching. Which model family are they planning to use? 
lin: also need to confirm model size and token profiles. If they use a 7B quantized model we can likely hit it with a single dedicated pool + autoscale. Larger models change the math.
clare: @james can you confirm the expected average prompt length and concurrency pattern? 100 qps peak could be bursty.
james (CrescentPay): Average prompt ~120 tokens, responses ~60 tokens. Traffic is customer-facing chat, bursts up to 150 qps for short windows.
sara: current asks from sales: get a firm delivery date or propose phased commitment. They want to announce integration in their roadmap if we commit to May.
raj: realistic engineering options:
1) Offer phased rollout: (A) Private VPC + BYOK KMS + Embeddings & Sync API by May 15, (B) Full 100 qps production traffic by June 15 after soak testing.
2) Or commit full stack by May 15 but require a feature flag with early throttling and a strict canary schedule.
lin: add ops requirements: network peering, VPN tunnels, firewall rules, certs. Ops lead needs 2 weeks to provision after contract signed. ops-bot: provisioning ticket created: INF-3142, ETA 14 days post-contract.
clare: Proposed acceptance criteria for May milestone:
```
- VPC peering established in us-west-2
- Customer-managed KMS integrated and tested for model keys
- Private control plane configured and audited
- Embeddings + chat endpoint available in staging
- Initial canary (10 qps) validated over 48h with perf <= 300ms p50
```
raj: That seems doable if we scope May to staging + limited canary. Full 100 qps in production requires capacity reservation and load testing. Estimate: 3-4 engineer-weeks + infra provisioning.
sara: Sales will push back if we don't give May date for production. They said marketing timeline is tight.
clare: Let's present a compromise: public commitment — "Private VPC & KMS + staging canary available by May 15; GA production (100 qps) by June 15 pending capacity reservation."
james (CrescentPay): That wording could work if you add an SLA target for GA and an agreed fallback plan if GA is delayed. We need documented fallback (rate limiting to 60 qps + model variants) so our service isn't fully degraded.
lin: fallback plan note: enable model autoscaling to smaller quantized variants and apply prefix KV caching to reduce per-token work. We can cap bursts with a queueing layer.
raj: I'll draft capacity numbers and cost delta for reserved pool vs burst. If they want a SLA, we should propose a reserved commit (monthly) to guarantee 100 qps and include penalty-free rollback for 30 days.
clare: Action items:
- raj: capacity & cost estimate for 100 qps reserved pool (due EOD tomorrow)
- lin: ops checklist + provisioning timeline (due in 2 business days)
- sara: update CrescentPay with phased commitment draft and ask for formal sign-off on peering & KMS by next Wednesday
- james: confirm concurrency shape and whether they can accept initial canary at 10 qps
ops-bot: INF-3142 updated with checklist link: https://redwood.company/infra/INF-3142
sara: I'll coordinate with legal on BYOK terms after they confirm KMS vendor.
james (CrescentPay): We can accept the canary at 10 qps next week. We'll escalate KMS vendor details by EOD tomorrow.
clare: Great. If all items line up we'll propose the staged commitment wording to marketing and legal. Anyone object?
raj: No objections. I'll post the capacity estimate when ready.
lin: No objections. I'll sync with oncall for peering windows.
sara: Thanks all — will close the loop with CrescentPay and loop legal. :thumbsup:
